Design baseline v1 · 22 October 2026

School platform database design

One shared PostgreSQL database. Explicit module ownership. One school per tenant. Start with the user service; preserve the complete product model.

Reviewable design, not a deployed database. All table/column references are statically checked. DDL has not been executed against PostgreSQL here. Role grants, auth bootstrap, state-transition functions and cross-row enforcement must be implemented and tested before production.

Executable implementation · 25 October 2026: F01 is merged in the separate campus-core-api repository. F02 authentication is preserved in an unmerged, deferred branch; it will move to tenant-user-service. F04 business logic is next in campus-core-api. Executable migrations, when adopted, take precedence over corresponding draft tables in this catalogue. See the authentication design and evidence and implementation status. See the service ownership decision. The complete catalogue SQL is not a release migration bundle.

233tables across the full product
17owned database schemas
643declared foreign keys

Storage responsibilities

PostgreSQL · durable

Users, memberships, credentials, sessions, policy versions, selected security events, business records, audit evidence, idempotency, financial usage and quota reservations.

Memory / Redis · ephemeral

Per-IP, principal, tenant and route rate counters; short-lived concurrency tokens and cached published policy versions. Bounded local memory is a single-process pilot option. Shared Redis is required for consistent limits across API processes.

Private object storage / telemetry

Attachments, contracts, PDFs and galleries in private S3. Raw request logs, traces and metrics go through a bounded collector/log sink, not a PostgreSQL insert for every request.

“Service” means a module boundary in the initial modular monolith. It does not require a separate server, database or user-service HTTP call on every request.

Confirmed channel: WhatsApp single and bulk messages

Single and bulk sends share notices, approved audience snapshots, per-recipient deliveries, attempts and callbacks. Recommend a school-owned sender identity, English/Hindi approved template versions, guardian opt-in/out evidence and optional portal membership. Recipients do not need an app login to receive a WhatsApp message; private records and action links still require verification.

Use one configured official API integration per sender. A cost classifier checks message purpose, template approval, live service-window eligibility, monthly allowance, provider fees and school budget. Zero-Meta-fee and paid messages use the same API; bulk size alone never selects a free route. Keep rate rules effective-dated and reconcile usage/billing callbacks.

Compare free allowance, testing options and paid providers. The comparison includes a message-count eligibility explorer and the current sources checked on 22 October 2026.

Start here: user service

Edge protection→Authenticate session→Check membership→Permission + resource scope→Tenant-scoped transaction
  1. Identity: iam.users, user_contacts, password_credentials, external_identities. A user can belong to multiple schools. Verified family contact information is not globally unique.
  2. School access: memberships, school_login_identifiers, roles, permissions, role_permissions, membership_role_assignments and typed year/section/offering scopes.
  3. Platform access: separate platform roles and assignments. The operator needs an explicit school-approved control.support_grants record before accessing private school records.
  4. Sessions and recovery: sessions, action_tokens, auth_challenges, mfa_factors, mfa_recovery_codes. Raw high-entropy tokens stay out of the DB; short OTPs need a server-keyed digest. MFA secret material is encrypted with a key outside the database.
  5. Revocation: check user security_version, session state and membership permission_version. Credential/permission changes invalidate access without waiting for a long-lived role claim to expire.
  6. Resource authority: a role alone does not prove a teacher assignment or guardian relationship. Check academics.teacher_assignments and people.student_guardians, including effective dates and restrictions.

Opaque cookie sessions are the initial mode. No redundant refresh-token table is included. Use an established auth library where practical and map these domain requirements to its audited persistence model instead of maintaining two credential stores.

Request paths

PathDatabase workTraffic controls
Unauthenticated loginResolve school username narrowly; verify credential/MFA; create one session; record selected security event.IP-prefix + school/identifier HMAC + combined principal/IP limits. Dummy credential verification and generic errors reduce account enumeration.
Ordinary authenticated readSession and membership check; permission check; scoped query. Coalesce activity timestamps.Tenant + user + route limits. No per-request counter writes in PostgreSQL.
Reset / setup / MFAAtomic challenge consumption, expiry and attempts check; token bound to intended user and school.Independent stricter endpoint policies, resend caps and account-wide attempts. Avoid attacker-triggered permanent account lockout.
Export / messages / AIAtomic durable quota reservation plus outbox; worker rechecks authorisation before side effects.Request rate + concurrent-job caps + provider/budget controls. These are different mechanisms.

Lots of traffic: four different kinds of data

  1. Live rate counters: keys such as rl:v{policyRevision}:login:ip:{HMAC(prefix)}, rl:v{policyRevision}:login:principal:{HMAC(school+username)} and rl:v{policyRevision}:api:tenant:{tenantId}:user:{userId}:route:{routeGroup}. Bound key cardinality; expire counters. Policy revision is global plus a tenant-override revision. A Redis script must combine increment/refill, expiry and decision atomically; INCR followed by a separate EXPIRE can leave bad state after a crash.
  2. Security evidence: selected/coalesced success, failure, restriction and privilege-change events in iam.security_events. Never store raw secrets, unbounded headers or request bodies. Rotate keyed IP/principal digests under a documented correlation policy.
  3. Operational telemetry: bounded-route aggregates, latency histograms, 429/5xx rates and queue metrics. Proposed retention: raw logs 7–14 days in a log sink, minute aggregates 7 days, daily aggregates 90 days. Those are design defaults, not legal requirements.
  4. Business usage: durable quota_buckets, quota_reservations and idempotent usage_events. Exact amounts and transactions protect money, downloads and provider spend; approximate telemetry must never determine balances.

Enforcement and failure policy

Edge limits reject obvious bursts before password hashing or body parsing. API guards enforce endpoint, identity and tenant policies. Trust forwarding headers only from configured proxies; use canonical IP prefixes so IPv6 rotation does not create unlimited independent identities. Authorisation remains mandatory even when a limiter allows the request.

Single-process in-memory counters reset on restart and do not combine across cluster workers. Add a shared limiter before multiple API processes. Redis outage: login/reset/MFA and expensive endpoints reject or apply a deliberately conservative local fallback; ordinary reads may use bounded local protection. Never silently remove all limits. Return 429 with a bounded Retry-After value when throttled.

Request rate, concurrent work, database connections, body size, execution timeout and per-school paid usage are separate limits. One noisy school gets a queue/usage cap rather than starving all other schools. Anti-abuse limits cannot be raised by school admins editing tenant settings.

Partitioning and retention

Baseline DDL keeps event/rollup tables unpartitioned. Measure actual ingest, cleanup and query cost before converting to daily/monthly range partitions. A partitioned unique/primary key must include its partition key. Keep globally deduplicated payment/webhook source keys in a separate stable ledger rather than accidentally weakening uniqueness by adding a date partition. Partition creation, expiry and index maintenance are operational jobs, not automatic benefits of a timestamp column.

Database conventions and security contract

  • School tables use PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id); references to school tables use the same tenant column. This blocks cross-school relationships. UUID values are generated by PostgreSQL here; the application may supply them.
  • Every table includes created_at. Editable tables include updated_at and optimistic version. Services must update both explicitly; a default timestamp is not an automatic update trigger.
  • School tables have ENABLE/FORCE RLS using transaction-local app.tenant_id. The DDL supplies no application grants. Create separate non-owner runtime roles and a migration owner; no runtime BYPASSRLS, schema DDL, TRUNCATE or owner credentials.
  • RLS here enforces the tenant boundary, not every role or private field. A narrow identity/bootstrap access path validates sessions and resolves only the current user's memberships before ordinary school queries. Global IAM, platform commerce, webhook payloads and raw security data need separate role grants/APIs. Default tenant policy is not enough for that bootstrap.
  • platform_tenant tables hold a school reference but are platform-owned commercial/support records; they intentionally do not get the school RLS policy. Only dedicated platform roles may access them. School-facing views use narrowly authorised services.
  • Financial amounts are exact PostgreSQL decimals; transport them as decimal strings or minor-unit integers, never JavaScript floating point. School currency begins as INR; cross-currency accounting is not silently implied by a currency column.
  • Use timestamptz for instants, date for local school days, and explicit school timezone. Do not force an April-start academic year; actual school and financial years are configuration.
  • Foreign keys default to RESTRICT. User disable/withdrawal, receipt reversal and published report correction retain evidence. Avoid blanket cascading deletes and blanket soft-delete filters.
  • JSONB is limited to versioned configuration, snapshots, form definitions, provider envelopes and reviewed AI documents. Authoritative relationships and amounts are typed columns/FKs.
  • Append-oriented is a design label, not a permission grant. Implement role privileges, mutation guards and controlled posting/transition functions before production. Separate immutable content from approvals/revocation records.

Cross-row rules that still require implementation

RuleRequired implementation and test
Role scope kind matches typed scope rowControlled grant transaction / deferred validation; permission-version increment; grantor cannot grant beyond allowed authority.
Guardian/student account mapping and teacher assignmentsVerify same person, membership, academic year and effective dates; revocation and transfer tests.
Placement/year consistency and no overlapsLocked enrolment workflow or deferred constraints/triggers; same-year sections; no competing active roll numbers.
Fee/payment/refund/allocation consistencyLock related balance aggregates in consistent order; enforce same student and currency; reserve refunds; idempotent source keys.
Balanced immutable journals / period closeControlled posting procedure with cross-line sum check; period lock shared with close; direct posted-row writes denied.
Receipt/order/invoice matchingValidate parent identities, item/supplier/currency, accepted quantities, tolerance and source uniqueness under locks.
Paper/message approval and report historyApproval binds exact version/digest; current revision pointer consistency; corrections create new evidence; published data cannot mutate silently.
Quotas, stock, custody and loansAtomic reserve/commit/release; lock stock/copy/asset state; partial unique indexes alone do not validate ownership state.
Files, deletion and confidential attachment accessAuthorised object lifecycle; immutable keys; verify scanning; version-to-parent alignment; apply category-specific read policies.

Migration and implementation order

  1. Foundation: schemas, customer/tenant roots, IAM identity, memberships/roles, files, policy configuration, audit and reliable inbox/outbox. Provision a school with one administrator and prove isolation before expanding.
  2. Academics: staff, academic years/sections, teaching assignments, students/guardians, enrolment/placement and attendance.
  3. Pilot: homework, WhatsApp single/bulk notices with approved templates and budget controls, fee schedules/charges, manual school payment reconciliation, receipts and reversals.
  4. Assessment: richer communication automations, exam papers, attempts, marks and report publications; online school payments when merchant ownership is agreed.
  5. Resources: suppliers, locations, stock, assets, library, purchasing and matching; accountant-approved GL posting and cutover.
  6. Events and AI: approved galleries/packages/grants, then reviewed reusable AI drafts with reserved spending limits.

Cross-module foreign keys create a few intentional cycles. The full DDL creates all tables first, then adds foreign keys. Incremental production migrations introduce those constraints only when the referenced module exists; do not deploy every future table solely because it is present in this design.

Acceptance gates

Run migrations against the chosen PostgreSQL version; query pg_catalog to check keys/indexes/RLS; use restricted runtime roles for isolation tests; test connection reuse, auth-token replay/expiry, multi-process limiting, Redis failure, allocation/loan/stock races, duplicate callbacks, posting/close races and a timed backup restore. Static catalogue checks cannot prove these runtime properties.

Relationship map

Identity and authority

users → memberships → role assignments → permission bundles
memberships → staff / guardian accounts / student accounts
users → sessions / MFA / single-use actions
teacher assignment + guardian relationship → resource access

School academics

tenant → year → section → subject offering
student → yearly enrolment → placement history
attendance session → entries → revisions
homework → recipient → submission → feedback

Money and resources

schedule → charge → allocation ← payment → receipt
supplier → purchase order → receipt → stock / asset / book copy
book title → copies → loans → returns / renewals
supplier invoice → matched payment → balanced journal

Evidence and publication

paper → version → review → lock → release
attempt → mark revision → report publication → student report
notice version + audience → approval → private deliveries
event → gallery version → filtered package → parent grant

Arrows are relationship summaries. Individual cards below expose the exact FK columns. Parent/version alignment within the same school is a separate workflow invariant where noted.

CREATE TABLE iam.users (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  display_name text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'invited',

  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CHECK (status IN ('invited','active','locked','disabled')),
  CHECK (security_version > 0),

Delete expired sessions after a short operational window; security events retain separate evidence

Store a digest of high-entropy token; cookie holds raw token. No JWT refresh table is required for opaque session mode. Coalesce last_seen writes; do not update on every HTTP request. Temporary-password sessions are restricted until replacement.

  authenticated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  idle_expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  absolute_expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL,

  restricted_purpose text,

  ip_hash bytea,
  user_agent_hash bytea,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (token_hash),
  CHECK (idle_expires_at <= absolute_expires_at),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  channel_account_id uuid NOT NULL,
  notice_version_id uuid NOT NULL,

  destination_digest bytea,
  state text NOT NULL,
  dedupe_key text NOT NULL,
  estimated_cost numeric(18,6),
  estimated_cost_currency char(3),
  usage_reservation_id uuid,
  delivered_at timestamptz,
  last_error_code text,

  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, recipient_id, channel_account_id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, dedupe_key),
  CHECK (estimated_cost IS NULL OR estimated_cost >= 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

Only verified inbound user messages open/reset the 24-hour service window; outbound sends and read receipts do not. Out-of-order callbacks use max validated event timestamp. A phone match alone cannot authenticate a guardian or child.

Row checks

CREATE TABLE comms.whatsapp_threads (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  sender_id uuid NOT NULL,
  guardian_id uuid,
  destination_digest bytea NOT NULL,
  destination_ciphertext bytea NOT NULL,
  last_user_message_at timestamptz,
  service_window_expires_at timestamptz,
  state text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, sender_id, destination_digest),
  CHECK ((last_user_message_at IS NULL) = (service_window_expires_at IS NULL)),
  CHECK (service_window_expires_at IS NULL OR service_window_expires_at = last_user_message_at + interval '24 hours'),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

Complete PostgreSQL design DDL

Tables first, constraints second. This is a full-product design draft, not a production migration bundle. Required role grants and controlled cross-row/workflow enforcement remain release gates.

Inspect all SQL · 233 tables · 643 foreign keys
-- School SaaS database design v1 — 22 October 2026

-- PostgreSQL 16+ design DDL. All tables are a full-scope catalogue, not an MVP deployment instruction.

-- No application role grants, seed data, posting functions, workflow triggers or service code are supplied.

-- Static relationship checks performed; no real PostgreSQL execution claimed.

BEGIN;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS control;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS iam;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS traffic;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ops;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS files;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS academics;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS people;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS attendance;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS learning;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS comms;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS exams;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS fees;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS resources;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS procurement;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS accounting;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS events;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ai;

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS app_private;

CREATE FUNCTION app_private.current_tenant_id() RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
$$;

CREATE TABLE control.customers (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  legal_name text NOT NULL,
  display_name text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prospect',
  billing_address jsonb,
  tax_reference text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CHECK (status IN ('prospect','active','closed')),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.customer_contacts (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  customer_id uuid NOT NULL,
  name text NOT NULL,
  email text,
  phone text,
  purpose text NOT NULL,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CHECK (email IS NOT NULL OR phone IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.tenants (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  customer_id uuid NOT NULL,
  school_code text NOT NULL,
  display_name text NOT NULL,
  timezone text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Kolkata',
  currency char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR',
  access_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  activated_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (school_code),
  CHECK (access_state IN ('pending','active','read_only','suspended','closed')),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.plan_versions (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  plan_code text NOT NULL,
  revision integer NOT NULL,
  name text NOT NULL,
  published_at timestamptz,
  currency char(3) NOT NULL,
  definition jsonb NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (plan_code, revision),
  CHECK (revision > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.contracts (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  customer_id uuid NOT NULL,
  contract_number text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (contract_number),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.contract_versions (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  contract_id uuid NOT NULL,
  revision integer NOT NULL,
  terms_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL,
  content_sha256 char(64) NOT NULL,
  accepted_at timestamptz,
  accepted_by_contact_id uuid,
  document_object_id uuid,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (contract_id, revision)
);

CREATE TABLE control.documents (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  customer_id uuid NOT NULL,
  bucket_alias text NOT NULL,
  object_key text NOT NULL,
  storage_version_id text,
  byte_size bigint NOT NULL,
  sha256 char(64) NOT NULL,
  uploaded_by uuid NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (bucket_alias, object_key),
  CHECK (byte_size >= 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.subscriptions (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  contract_version_id uuid NOT NULL,
  plan_version_id uuid NOT NULL,
  starts_on date NOT NULL,
  ends_on date,
  status text NOT NULL,
  grace_until timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.subscription_items (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  subscription_id uuid NOT NULL,
  kind text NOT NULL,
  description text NOT NULL,
  amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  interval_months integer,
  starts_on date NOT NULL,
  ends_on date,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (kind IN ('subscription','maintenance','setup','addon')),
  CHECK (amount >= 0),
  CHECK (interval_months IS NULL OR interval_months > 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.platform_invoices (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  subscription_id uuid NOT NULL,
  invoice_number text NOT NULL,
  currency char(3) NOT NULL,
  issued_on date NOT NULL,
  due_on date NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL,
  subtotal numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  tax_total numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  total numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  recipient_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (invoice_number),
  CHECK (total = subtotal + tax_total),
  CHECK (due_on >= issued_on),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.platform_invoice_lines (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  invoice_id uuid NOT NULL,
  subscription_item_id uuid,
  line_number integer NOT NULL,
  description text NOT NULL,
  period_start date,
  period_end date,
  quantity numeric(18,4) NOT NULL,
  unit_price numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  tax_amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  line_total numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  source_key text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, invoice_id, line_number),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, source_key),
  CHECK (quantity > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.platform_payments (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  customer_id uuid NOT NULL,
  merchant_code text NOT NULL,
  provider text NOT NULL,
  provider_payment_ref text,
  amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  currency char(3) NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL,
  settled_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (provider, merchant_code, provider_payment_ref),
  CHECK (amount > 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.platform_payment_allocations (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  payment_id uuid NOT NULL,
  invoice_id uuid NOT NULL,
  amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  allocated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  reversed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (amount > 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.platform_credit_notes (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  invoice_id uuid NOT NULL,
  credit_number text NOT NULL,
  amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  reason text NOT NULL,
  issued_on date NOT NULL,
  approved_by uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (credit_number),
  CHECK (amount > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.provisioning_runs (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  idempotency_key text NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL,
  requested_by uuid NOT NULL,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  last_error_code text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, idempotency_key),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.provisioning_steps (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  run_id uuid NOT NULL,
  step_code text NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL,
  attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  result_reference text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, run_id, step_code),
  CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.support_grants (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  operator_user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  approved_by_user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  reason text NOT NULL,
  starts_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  approval_evidence text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (expires_at > starts_at),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE control.support_grant_permissions (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  support_grant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  permission_id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, support_grant_id, permission_id)
);

CREATE TABLE control.tenant_settings (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  setting_key text NOT NULL,
  value jsonb NOT NULL,
  changed_by uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, setting_key),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.users (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  display_name text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'invited',
  preferred_locale text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en-IN',
  security_version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  disabled_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CHECK (status IN ('invited','active','locked','disabled')),
  CHECK (security_version > 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.user_contacts (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  kind text NOT NULL,
  normalized_value text NOT NULL,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  is_primary boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (user_id, kind, normalized_value),
  CHECK (kind IN ('email','phone')),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.password_credentials (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  password_hash text NOT NULL,
  algorithm text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'argon2id',
  changed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  must_change boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  temporary_expires_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (user_id),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.external_identities (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  issuer text NOT NULL,
  subject text NOT NULL,
  linked_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (issuer, subject),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.memberships (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'invited',
  permission_version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  joined_at timestamptz,
  ends_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_id),
  CHECK (state IN ('invited','active','suspended','left')),
  CHECK (permission_version > 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.school_login_identifiers (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  membership_id uuid NOT NULL,
  normalized_username text NOT NULL,
  enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, normalized_username),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.permissions (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  code text NOT NULL,
  description text NOT NULL,
  resource_kind text NOT NULL,
  is_sensitive boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (code),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.roles (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  code text NOT NULL,
  name text NOT NULL,
  is_system boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, code),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.role_permissions (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  role_id uuid NOT NULL,
  permission_id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, role_id, permission_id)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.membership_role_assignments (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  membership_id uuid NOT NULL,
  role_id uuid NOT NULL,
  scope_kind text NOT NULL,
  starts_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  ends_at timestamptz,
  granted_by uuid NOT NULL,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (scope_kind IN ('school','academic_year','section','subject_offering','own_records')),
  CHECK (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.role_scope_years (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  assignment_id uuid NOT NULL,
  academic_year_id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, assignment_id, academic_year_id)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.role_scope_sections (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  assignment_id uuid NOT NULL,
  section_id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, assignment_id, section_id)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.role_scope_offerings (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  assignment_id uuid NOT NULL,
  offering_id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, assignment_id, offering_id)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.platform_roles (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  code text NOT NULL,
  name text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (code),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.platform_role_permissions (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  role_id uuid NOT NULL,
  permission_id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (role_id, permission_id)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.platform_user_roles (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  role_id uuid NOT NULL,
  granted_by uuid NOT NULL,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.sessions (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  token_hash bytea NOT NULL,
  authentication_level text NOT NULL,
  authenticated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  idle_expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  absolute_expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  security_version bigint NOT NULL,
  restricted_purpose text,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  ip_hash bytea,
  user_agent_hash bytea,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (token_hash),
  CHECK (idle_expires_at <= absolute_expires_at),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.action_tokens (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid,
  tenant_id uuid,
  purpose text NOT NULL,
  token_hash bytea NOT NULL,
  target_contact_id uuid,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  consumed_at timestamptz,
  attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  max_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
  subject_snapshot jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (token_hash),
  CHECK (purpose IN ('setup','password_reset','contact_verify','membership_invite')),
  CHECK (attempt_count >= 0),
  CHECK (max_attempts > 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.mfa_factors (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  kind text NOT NULL,
  label text NOT NULL,
  secret_ciphertext bytea,
  credential_id bytea,
  public_key bytea,
  sign_count bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_accepted_step bigint,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (credential_id),
  CHECK (kind IN ('totp','webauthn')),
  CHECK ((kind = 'totp' AND secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL) OR (kind = 'webauthn' AND credential_id IS NOT NULL AND public_key IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.mfa_recovery_codes (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  factor_id uuid NOT NULL,
  code_hash bytea NOT NULL,
  consumed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (factor_id, code_hash),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.auth_challenges (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid,
  challenge_hash bytea NOT NULL,
  purpose text NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  consumed_at timestamptz,
  attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  challenge_data jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (challenge_hash),
  CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.api_clients (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name text NOT NULL,
  client_key_hash bytea NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL,
  created_by_user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz,
  last_used_at timestamptz,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (client_key_hash),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.api_client_permissions (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id uuid NOT NULL,
  permission_id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, client_id, permission_id)
);

CREATE TABLE iam.security_events (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id uuid,
  user_id uuid,
  session_id uuid,
  event_code text NOT NULL,
  outcome text NOT NULL,
  occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  request_id uuid,
  ip_hash bytea,
  principal_key_hash bytea,
  details jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE traffic.rate_limit_policies (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  policy_code text NOT NULL,
  revision integer NOT NULL,
  route_group text NOT NULL,
  identity_kind text NOT NULL,
  algorithm text NOT NULL,
  window_ms integer NOT NULL,
  request_limit integer NOT NULL,
  burst_capacity integer,
  block_ms integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  failure_mode text NOT NULL,
  enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE (policy_code, revision),
  CHECK (revision > 0),
  CHECK (window_ms > 0),
  CHECK (request_limit > 0),
  CHECK (block_ms >= 0),
  CHECK (identity_kind IN ('ip_prefix','principal','tenant','api_client','principal_ip')),
  CHECK (failure_mode IN ('reject','local_fallback')),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE traffic.tenant_rate_overrides (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  policy_id uuid NOT NULL,
  request_limit integer NOT NULL,
  burst_capacity integer,
  expires_at timestamptz,
  approved_by uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, policy_id),
  CHECK (request_limit > 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE traffic.access_restrictions (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id uuid,
  subject_kind text NOT NULL,
  subject_hash bytea NOT NULL,
  reason_code text NOT NULL,
  starts_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  created_by_user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CHECK (expires_at > starts_at),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE traffic.request_rollups_minute (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id uuid,
  bucket_start timestamptz NOT NULL,
  route_group text NOT NULL,
  method text NOT NULL,
  status_class smallint NOT NULL,
  request_count bigint NOT NULL,
  rejected_count bigint NOT NULL,
  duration_sum_ms bigint NOT NULL,
  duration_histogram jsonb NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CHECK (request_count >= 0),
  CHECK (rejected_count >= 0),
  CHECK (duration_sum_ms >= 0),
  CHECK (status_class BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE traffic.request_rollups_daily (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id uuid,
  day date NOT NULL,
  route_group text NOT NULL,
  request_count bigint NOT NULL,
  rejected_count bigint NOT NULL,
  bytes_out bigint NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CHECK (request_count >= 0),
  CHECK (rejected_count >= 0),
  CHECK (bytes_out >= 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE traffic.quota_policies (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  metric_code text NOT NULL,
  period_kind text NOT NULL,
  limit_value numeric(20,4) NOT NULL,
  hard_limit boolean NOT NULL,
  effective_from timestamptz NOT NULL,
  effective_until timestamptz,
  policy_source text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (limit_value >= 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE traffic.quota_buckets (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  quota_policy_id uuid NOT NULL,
  period_start timestamptz NOT NULL,
  period_end timestamptz NOT NULL,
  committed numeric(20,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  reserved numeric(20,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, quota_policy_id, period_start),
  CHECK (period_end > period_start),
  CHECK (committed >= 0),
  CHECK (reserved >= 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE traffic.quota_reservations (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  bucket_id uuid NOT NULL,
  operation_key text NOT NULL,
  amount numeric(20,4) NOT NULL,
  actual_amount numeric(20,4),
  state text NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, operation_key),
  CHECK (amount > 0),
  CHECK (actual_amount IS NULL OR actual_amount >= 0),
  CHECK (state IN ('reserved','committed','released','expired')),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE traffic.usage_events (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  metric_code text NOT NULL,
  source_key text NOT NULL,
  quantity numeric(20,4) NOT NULL,
  occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,

  CHECK (status IN ('not_recorded','present','absent','late','excused')),
  CHECK (revision > 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  guardian_id uuid NOT NULL,
  channel_account_id uuid NOT NULL,
  action text NOT NULL,
  purpose_scope text NOT NULL,
  destination_digest bytea NOT NULL,
  notice_version_reference text NOT NULL,
  evidence_reference text NOT NULL,
  recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  recorded_by uuid,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (action IN ('opt_in','opt_out','reconfirm'))
);

CREATE TABLE comms.whatsapp_threads (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  sender_id uuid NOT NULL,
  guardian_id uuid,
  destination_digest bytea NOT NULL,
  destination_ciphertext bytea NOT NULL,
  last_user_message_at timestamptz,
  service_window_expires_at timestamptz,
  state text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, sender_id, destination_digest),
  CHECK ((last_user_message_at IS NULL) = (service_window_expires_at IS NULL)),
  CHECK (service_window_expires_at IS NULL OR service_window_expires_at = last_user_message_at + interval '24 hours'),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE comms.whatsapp_inbound_messages (

  handling_state text NOT NULL,

);

  CHECK (service_monthly_free_allowance >= 0),
  CHECK (effective_until IS NULL OR effective_until > effective_from)

  last_provider_sync_at timestamptz,

  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),

  CHECK (service_reserved >= 0),

CREATE TABLE comms.whatsapp_delivery_payloads (

  pricing_version_id uuid NOT NULL,
  send_mode text NOT NULL,
  payload_ciphertext bytea NOT NULL,
  payload_sha256 char(64) NOT NULL,
  estimated_pricing_reason text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, delivery_id),
  CHECK (send_mode IN ('template','service')),
  CHECK ((send_mode = 'template' AND template_version_id IS NOT NULL) OR (send_mode = 'service' AND template_version_id IS NULL))
);

  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, accession_number),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, barcode),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE resources.library_loans (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  copy_id uuid NOT NULL,
  student_id uuid,
  staff_id uuid,
  issued_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  due_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  returned_at timestamptz,
  issued_by uuid NOT NULL,
  returned_by uuid,
  return_condition text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK ((student_id IS NOT NULL)::integer + (staff_id IS NOT NULL)::integer = 1),
  CHECK (due_at > issued_at),
  CHECK (returned_at IS NULL OR returned_at >= issued_at),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE resources.loan_renewals (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,

  renewed_by uuid NOT NULL,
  reason text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (new_due_at > old_due_at)
);

CREATE TABLE resources.library_charge_decisions (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  loan_id uuid NOT NULL,
  decision_key text NOT NULL,
  charge_kind text NOT NULL,
  amount numeric(18,2) NOT NULL,
  reason text NOT NULL,
  approved_by uuid NOT NULL,
  fee_charge_id uuid,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, decision_key),
  CHECK (amount >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE resources.library_holds (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,

  title_id uuid NOT NULL,
  student_id uuid,
  staff_id uuid,
  requested_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz,
  state text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK ((student_id IS NOT NULL)::integer + (staff_id IS NOT NULL)::integer = 1),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE resources.stocktakes (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  location_id uuid NOT NULL,
  started_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  closed_at timestamptz,
  state text NOT NULL,
  approved_by uuid,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),

);

  observed_quantity numeric(20,6) NOT NULL,

  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),

  CHECK (NOT (asset_id IS NOT NULL AND copy_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

);

CREATE TABLE procurement.receipt_lines (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  receipt_id uuid NOT NULL,
  order_line_id uuid NOT NULL,
  location_id uuid NOT NULL,
  delivered_quantity numeric(20,6) NOT NULL,

  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (delivered_quantity > 0),
  CHECK (accepted_quantity >= 0),
  CHECK (rejected_quantity >= 0),

);

);

  posted_at timestamptz,
  reverses_journal_id uuid,

  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  line_number integer NOT NULL,

  cost_centre_id uuid,
  debit numeric(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  credit numeric(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, journal_id, line_number),
  CHECK (debit >= 0),
  CHECK (credit >= 0),

);

  manifest_sha256 char(64) NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL,
  object_id uuid,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, gallery_version_id, variant, audience_sha256, manifest_sha256),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE events.download_grants (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  package_id uuid NOT NULL,
  guardian_account_id uuid NOT NULL,
  token_hash bytea NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  max_redemptions integer,
  redemption_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (token_hash),
  CHECK (redemption_count >= 0),
  CHECK (max_redemptions IS NULL OR max_redemptions > 0),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE events.download_redemptions (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  grant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  redeemed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  storage_url_expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  request_id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
);

CREATE TABLE ai.prompt_template_versions (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  template_code text NOT NULL,
  revision integer NOT NULL,
  template_text text NOT NULL,
  input_schema jsonb NOT NULL,
  output_schema jsonb NOT NULL,
  approved_by uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, template_code, revision)
);

CREATE TABLE ai.requests (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  requested_by uuid NOT NULL,
  template_version_id uuid NOT NULL,
  task_kind text NOT NULL,
  provider text NOT NULL,
  model_code text NOT NULL,
  source_manifest jsonb NOT NULL,
  reservation_id uuid NOT NULL,
  source_key text NOT NULL,
  state text NOT NULL,
  input_fingerprint char(64) NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, source_key),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE ai.generations (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  request_id uuid NOT NULL,
  attempt_number integer NOT NULL,
  output_json jsonb NOT NULL,
  provider_request_reference text,
  input_tokens bigint NOT NULL,
  output_tokens bigint NOT NULL,
  actual_cost numeric(18,6) NOT NULL,
  generated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, request_id, attempt_number),
  CHECK (input_tokens >= 0),
  CHECK (output_tokens >= 0),
  CHECK (actual_cost >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE ai.review_decisions (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  generation_id uuid NOT NULL,
  reviewed_by uuid NOT NULL,
  decision text NOT NULL,
  review_note text,
  reviewed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (decision IN ('approved','changes_requested','rejected'))
);

CREATE TABLE ai.teaching_plan_versions (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  offering_id uuid NOT NULL,
  syllabus_version_id uuid NOT NULL,
  revision integer NOT NULL,
  source_generation_id uuid,
  plan_json jsonb NOT NULL,
  approved_by uuid,
  approved_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  UNIQUE (tenant_id, offering_id, revision)
);

CREATE TABLE ai.catchup_packs (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  offering_id uuid NOT NULL,
  starts_on date NOT NULL,
  ends_on date NOT NULL,
  source_generation_id uuid,
  source_teaching_manifest jsonb NOT NULL,
  content jsonb NOT NULL,
  approved_by uuid,
  published_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
  CHECK (ends_on >= starts_on),
  CHECK (version > 0)
);

Technical references

  • PostgreSQL row security — policy behaviour, FORCE RLS and privileged-role exceptions.
  • PostgreSQL constraints — row checks, keys and relationship enforcement.
  • PostgreSQL partitioning — lifecycle and partition-key uniqueness limits.
  • NestJS throttling — in-memory defaults and custom/shared storage.
  • Redis counter and rate-limiter patterns — increment/expiry atomicity considerations.
  • OWASP authentication — login protection, recovery and generic error handling.
  • OWASP password storage — password hashing design.

Retention windows and rate-limit values are proposed product/operational defaults, not statutory conclusions or measured capacity guarantees. Accountant, school and privacy reviews remain necessary before live use.

All design deliverables are HTML · SQL is embedded for review · No secrets or live school records
